segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Good evening Mehta sir, I wanted to talk about Detol antiseptic liquid and the new Detol handwash for your counter.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Dettol sells, but many patients now ask for the cheaper Patanjali handwash.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Your regular customers already trust Detol. And we have new sample bottles for your regular patients.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Samples are fine, but the margin on Detol is lower than the other brands.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Sir, if you push Detol this month, आपको दिवाली पे एक gift hamper भी मिलेगा personally from my side.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Gift hamper. Ok, ok. Send twenty bottles of Dettol antiseptic and ten hand wash.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Done, sir. Twenty antiseptic and ten hand wash delivery tomorrow.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Also, the doctor next door says Dettol liquid should not be used undiluted on wounds. Tell your team to mention that.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes sir, I will note that.
